description:
An Undeniably Dominating Experience.
Color: Shadow Black

Designed for performance, the Spyder is stiffer and aerodynamic where it needs to be for acceleration and sustained speed, and yet compliant for comfort. All elements of the trike converge to deliver a performance machine which will satisfy your inner speed freak.

The Spyder’s frame is comprised of a two-piece aluminum Y-frame design. These two couple together to deliver a perfect balance of performance and compliance. The frame also sits low to the ground, giving riders optimal aerodynamics.

The 700c rear wheel is mounted via a through axel for increased rigidity. The new, innovative idler pulley improves chain engagement and power transfer, while deep profile TerraTrike rims, Schwalbe Kojak tires, and TerraTrike alloy hubs cleanly propel the trike.

Feel pure comfort and control in the Spyder’s new Sport Touring seat, made of a breathable mesh and an adjustable upper-back support section. The vertical controls and bar-end shifters give more room and increase aerodynamics, while the Shimano Deore hydraulic brakes provide total control over the machine. Finally, the internal cable routing gives a sleek and aggressive look to your ride.
